entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. S.K. Dash, learned counsel has entered appearance on behalf of the Informant by filing vakalatnama.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the informant.
3.

The Petitioner is an accused in Special G.R. Case No. 9 of 2004 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl. District Judge-Cum-Special Court, under POCSO Act, Puri arising out of Kumbharpada P.S. Case No. 34 of 2023 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/506 of IPC r/w Sec. 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Special G.R. Case No. 9 of 2004 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
District Judge-Cum-Special Court under POCSO Act by order dated 10.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 07.02.2023 and charge sheet has been filed on 24.03.2023.
6. Learned counsel for the State as well as the informant oppose the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: 7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement, submitted by the learned counsel for the State.
8. Considering the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain this BLAPL.
9. Accordingly, this BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Leave is granted to renew his prayer after examination of the victim.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
